contradictions.what: Rep says no moment and nothing to do, yet later says the analysis found fixable issues and arrived three weeks late after the test finished.
Rep says 'we weren't really pitching' but we answered with the Authorization Boost deck and Adaptive Acceptance.
Account called healthy and not on anyone's list, yet no review in 9-10 months, no contact with Stefan, and Stefan says Stripe only reached out when he said he was leaving.
Rep says nobody wanted to rip anything out and they like the product, yet Stefan asked to split the contract and the international business went to local acquiring.
